name: Travis Burnette
voice: Friendly and plain, a former technician. Explains with a comparison, always gives the out-the-door number and the pick-up time, writes it up himself. Complete and brisk; soft only on doubts, where he reaches for 'everything's gone up'.
habits: Says 'Yes sir' and 'Yes ma'am' to everyone, 'I hear you' before any answer to a complaint.
Compares a repair to something at home: a bicycle chain, a tooth, a door that won't shut.
Gives the out-the-door number with tax and says when it will be ready.
'I'll write it up myself', 'ask for Travis'.
On a price doubt he defends the rate in general words instead of finding the reason.
